item.title: PowerCut 0.5.4
item.description:
• Sony camera timecode is now written into Final Cut and Resolve exports, so DaVinci Resolve links FX3 and other Sony MP4 clips correctly.
  • Cut padding now applies to every cut, including removed takes and filler words, and the sliders update the edit reliably.
  • Words at the end of a sentence are no longer clipped when the next take is removed.
  • Striking and restoring words is much faster, and rapid edits no longer stall playback.
  • Reset buttons on the Pauses and Cut Padding panels.
  • Footage Brief highlights clear when you click elsewhere, and the auto pass shows its progress while it runs.

item.title: PowerCut 0.5.3
item.description:
PowerCut 0.5.3

  • Final Cut Pro imports without warnings. Exports now carry the format names Final Cut expects, so it no longer reports an unexpected value on the timeline or on multicam clips.
  • Better timeline size. The project is built on a standard Final Cut format chosen from the footage the cut is actually made of, rather than inheriting an odd capture size from whichever clip happened to be first. A screen recording in your story no longer sets the resolution for the whole project.
  • Multicam exports import cleanly, following on from the multicam fix in 0.5.2.

item.title: PowerCut 0.5.2
item.description:
PowerCut 0.5.2

  • Final Cut Pro multicam export fixed. The multicam option wrote a file Final Cut rejected without an error, so nothing appeared on import.
  • Cuts land where they should. Edit points are now found in the audio itself rather than from transcript timings, so clips start right before the first word and end after the last one finishes, with no chopped words and no dead air at the head.
  • Breaths and long pauses removed between sentences, with the padding sliders genuinely controlling how the edit breathes.
  • Much stronger repeat and false start detection: re-read lines are matched against your script, restarts buried inside a sentence are caught, and mis-transcribed repeats no longer slip through.
  • Run Auto Edit Pass now re-derives cleanly instead of layering on the previous pass, so improved detection applies to projects you already started.
  • Click a word to play from it. Clicking selects the word and starts playback at that moment.
  • New Project in the File menu, and Previous Projects on the name pill.
  • Smoother settings sliders with a confirmation before re-planning, a larger selection popup, and panels that stay usable at small window sizes.

item.title: PowerCut 0.5.1
item.description:
PowerCut 0.5.1

  • New transcript click model: click places the caret, double-click selects a word, triple-click selects a paragraph. Delete toggles strike and restore.
  • Playback speeds now go to 2x, with a compact speed menu next to the timeline play button.
  • Previous Projects dropdown on the project name pill, listing your five most recent projects.
  • Granular audio selection: pick the left or right channel of any track for transcription, right from the clip's context menu.
  • Larger default transcript text with a numeric size indicator.
  • Hover a clip to remove it, a visible audio track chip, and an optional auto-transcribe on import setting.
  • Many smaller fixes from tester feedback.

item.title: PowerCut 0.5.0
item.description:
PowerCut 0.5.0

First test build: on-device transcription and rough cuts, paper editing, the Auto Edit Pass, take detection, the review queue, versions, and export to Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Premiere Pro plus captions.
